name: What can go wrong with garage painting and trim work if it is done cheaply?
description: Cheap garage painting often fails because of weak prep, wrong products, or skipped primer. That can lead to peeling, blotchy coverage, and trim that looks rough

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with garage painting and trim work if it is done cheaply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, moisture, temperature swings, and poor surface prep can all cause peeling, cracking, or uneven coverage. In Colorado, garages also deal with dust and seasonal changes, so proper priming and choosing the right finish matter a lot.
